using_mode_note: Public Pythonic nested USING, dotted selectors and namespace choices follow ../pythonic-using.md; older nesting, field-selector and constant/call-name rejections below remain for the future strict milestone.
for_control_mode_note: Public Pythonic global-counter calls, read-only counter references and finally cleanup follow ../pythonic-for.md; older fresh-local-only, counter-reference and exceptional-counter observations below remain for the future strict milestone.
string_operation_mode_note: Public Pythonic SUB_STR clipping, zero counts, bounded results and empty INDEX searches follow ../string-operations.md; older substring/search rejections below remain for the future strict milestone.
text_format_mode_note: Public Pythonic dynamic WRITE, quoted fields and scientific conversion follow ../text-formats.md; earlier literal-only, quoted-content and scientific-format rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
array_shape_mode_note: Public Pythonic result declarations and first-dimension ARRAY_LEN follow ../array-result-shapes.md; older result-form and multidimensional-length rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
array_mode_note: Public Pythonic ARRAY value/result composition follows ../pythonic-arrays.md; older assignment-only and whole-value rejections below are retained for the future strict milestone.
evaluation_mode_note: Public Pythonic mode uses the chosen order in ../evaluation-order.md; older ordering rejections below are retained only for the future strict milestone.

source_rules.write_syntax: Omitted-file WRITE accepts a comma-separated list of expressions with optional INTEGER format specifiers; Pythonic expression support follows ../text-formats.md, or CR items.
source_rules.integer: Decimal output has a leading blank; width is a minimum field. The second specifier selects base 2..16; nondecimal width uses leading zeros.
source_rules.real: Default scientific output, minimum field widths and signed fractional precision selecting fixed/scientific forms.
source_rules.cr: Subsequent data starts on the next line.

implementation_choices.evaluation: Render each scalar once, left to right. Validate combined length after all item expressions. Send one completed outer statement to the recorder/callback.
implementation_choices.newline: LF, without automatic separators or a trailing newline unless requested.
implementation_choices.real: Finite Python floats; default .5E, nonnegative precision .nf, negative precision .nE; Python rounding.
implementation_choices.integer: Checked expression range and narrow storage; uppercase digits and minus signs for negative nondecimal values, without inferring controller two's-complement formatting.
implementation_choices.boolean: Existing leading-blank TRUE/FALSE with optional minimum width; no second specifier.
implementation_choices.resource_limits: Combined ASCII output <=254 characters; <=1024 items; numeric/BOOLEAN widths 0..254; REAL precision -254..254. The item/format bounds are prototype guards.
implementation_choices.errors: No outer request on render/length failure. Preserve prior expression effects and nested requests. Callback failures/interruption retain a complete request and unwind routine frames without retry.

retained_boundaries: Initialized known scalar values and existing ownership/type checks
Bounded STRING width/alignment, quoted truncation and doubled apostrophes follow ../text-formats.md
No aggregate output, explicit files/devices, binary transfer, READ or IO_STATUS
No native compiler or controller I/O equivalence claim; strict mode remains a future milestone
